---
title: "5_Cross_Study_Analysis"
author: "Noor-Ul-Haya Ahmed"
date: "2026"
output: pdf_document
description: >
  Cross-study consistency and cross-disease comparison analysis.
  Identifies robust genes (significant in 2+ datasets, concordant
  direction) within each disease. Compares gene sets across ALS,
  PD and VCP-myopathy using set intersection (UpSetR).
  GO, KEGG and Hallmark pathway enrichment on shared ALS/PD genes.
  Biomarker candidate prioritisation using weighted scoring
  framework incorporating consistency, effect size, pathway
  relevance, cross-disease evidence and tissue specificity.
  Results saved to Consistency/, Pathway/ and Biomarkers/.
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "...") # make own directory
```

```{r libraries}
# ============================================================
# LIBRARIES
# ============================================================
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(UpSetR)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(AnnotationDbi)

dir.create("Consistency", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("Pathway",     showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("Biomarkers",  showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load_de_results}
# ============================================================
# LOAD ALL DE RESULTS
# Standardised format: gene, log2FC, pvalue, padj,
#                      dataset, disease
# Excludes GSE100188 (small RNA — separate track)
# ============================================================

de_files <- list.files(
  "DE_Results",
  pattern    = "_DE_results.csv",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# exclude small RNA dataset from main analysis
de_files <- de_files[!grepl("GSE100188", de_files)]

all_de <- lapply(de_files, function(f){
  df      <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$gene <- as.character(df$gene)
  df
}) %>% bind_rows()

cat("Datasets loaded:", unique(all_de$dataset), "\n")
cat("Disease labels:", unique(all_de$disease), "\n")
cat("Total gene-dataset combinations:", nrow(all_de), "\n")
```

```{r consistency_analysis}
# ============================================================
# CROSS-STUDY CONSISTENCY ANALYSIS
# For each disease:
#   - Identify genes significant in 2+ datasets (padj < 0.05)
#   - Require concordant direction across datasets
#   - Save consistency results per disease
# ============================================================

diseases <- c("ALS", "PD", "VCP_myopathy", "AD")

consistency_results <- list()

for(dis in diseases){
  cat("\n--- Consistency:", dis, "---\n")

  dis_data <- all_de %>% filter(disease == dis)

  if(nrow(dis_data) == 0){
    cat("No data for", dis, "\n")
    next
  }

  # count datasets per gene and direction consistency
  gene_summary <- dis_data %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarise(
      n_datasets_total  = n(),
      n_datasets_sig    = sum(padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_up              = sum(padj < 0.05 & log2FC > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_down            = sum(padj < 0.05 & log2FC < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_log2FC       = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_abs_log2FC   = mean(abs(log2FC), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups           = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      direction_consistent = (n_up == n_datasets_sig) |
                             (n_down == n_datasets_sig),
      robust = n_datasets_sig >= 2 & direction_consistent
    )

  robust_genes <- gene_summary %>% filter(robust)

  cat("Total genes tested:", nrow(gene_summary), "\n")
  cat("Significant in 1+ datasets:",
      sum(gene_summary$n_datasets_sig >= 1), "\n")
  cat("Robust genes (2+ datasets, consistent direction):",
      nrow(robust_genes), "\n")

  consistency_results[[dis]] <- gene_summary

  write.csv(
    gene_summary,
    paste0("Consistency/", dis, "_consistency.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r cross_disease_comparison}
# ============================================================
# CROSS-DISEASE GENE SET COMPARISON
# Compare significant gene sets across diseases
# ALS/PD overlap at FDR < 0.05
# VCP-myopathy: nominal p < 0.05 (underpowered — n=3 controls)
# Direction concordant within each disease
# Direction NOT required to match between diseases
# ============================================================

# significant genes per disease (padj < 0.05)
als_sig <- all_de %>%
  filter(disease == "ALS", padj < 0.05) %>%
  pull(gene) %>% unique()

pd_sig <- all_de %>%
  filter(disease == "PD", padj < 0.05) %>%
  pull(gene) %>% unique()

# VCP-myopathy: nominal threshold (no FDR genes)
vcp_sig <- all_de %>%
  filter(disease == "VCP_myopathy", pvalue < 0.05) %>%
  pull(gene) %>% unique()

cat("ALS significant genes:", length(als_sig), "\n")
cat("PD significant genes:", length(pd_sig), "\n")
cat("VCP-myopathy nominal genes:", length(vcp_sig), "\n")

# UpSet plot
gene_list <- list(
  ALS          = als_sig,
  PD           = pd_sig,
  VCP_myopathy = vcp_sig
)

png("Consistency/CrossDisease_UpSet.png",
    width = 2400, height = 1800, res = 250)
upset(
  fromList(gene_list),
  order.by  = "freq",
  sets.bar.color = c("#D6604D", "#2166AC", "#4DAF4A"),
  text.scale = 1.5
)
dev.off()

cat("UpSet plot saved\n")

# ALS/PD shared genes
als_pd_shared <- intersect(als_sig, pd_sig)
cat("ALS/PD shared genes (FDR < 0.05):", length(als_pd_shared), "\n")

# direction check within each disease for shared genes
als_direction <- all_de %>%
  filter(disease == "ALS", gene %in% als_pd_shared, padj < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(als_log2FC = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

pd_direction <- all_de %>%
  filter(disease == "PD", gene %in% als_pd_shared, padj < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(pd_log2FC = mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

shared_direction <- als_direction %>%
  left_join(pd_direction, by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    als_dir    = ifelse(als_log2FC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
    pd_dir     = ifelse(pd_log2FC  > 0, "Up", "Down"),
    concordant = als_dir == pd_dir
  )

cat("Same direction (concordant):",
    sum(shared_direction$concordant, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Opposite direction:",
    sum(!shared_direction$concordant, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# binomial test for direction discordance
n_opposite <- sum(!shared_direction$concordant, na.rm = TRUE)
n_total    <- nrow(shared_direction)
binom_test <- binom.test(n_opposite, n_total, p = 0.5)
cat("Binomial test p-value:", binom_test$p.value, "\n")

write.csv(shared_direction,
          "Consistency/ALS_PD_shared_genes.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r pathway_enrichment}
# ============================================================
# PATHWAY ENRICHMENT — SHARED ALS/PD GENES
# GO biological process over-representation analysis
# KEGG pathway enrichment
# Hallmark gene set enrichment
# Input: 43 shared ALS/PD genes (41 with GO annotations)
# ============================================================

shared_genes <- als_pd_shared

cat("Input genes for enrichment:", length(shared_genes), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------
# GO ENRICHMENT
# ------------------------------------------
go_results <- enrichGO(
  gene          = shared_genes,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "SYMBOL",
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05
)

go_simplified <- simplify(go_results, cutoff = 0.7,
                           by = "p.adjust", select_fun = min)

cat("GO terms (simplified):", nrow(go_simplified@result), "\n")

# dotplot
p_go <- dotplot(go_simplified, showCategory = 20) +
  labs(title = "Shared ALS/PD Muscle Pathways (Simplified GO BP)")

ggsave("Pathway/ALS_PD_shared_GO_simplified_dotplot.png",
       plot = p_go, width = 10, height = 12, dpi = 300)

write.csv(go_simplified@result,
          "Pathway/ALS_PD_shared_GO_BP_simplified.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------
# KEGG ENRICHMENT
# ------------------------------------------
entrez_ids <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys      = shared_genes,
  column    = "ENTREZID",
  keytype   = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
)
entrez_ids <- entrez_ids[!is.na(entrez_ids)]

kegg_results <- enrichKEGG(
  gene          = entrez_ids,
  organism      = "hsa",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
)

cat("KEGG pathways significant:", nrow(kegg_results@result), "\n")

write.csv(kegg_results@result,
          "Pathway/ALS_PD_shared_KEGG.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# ------------------------------------------
# HALLMARK ENRICHMENT
# ------------------------------------------
hallmark_sets <- msigdbr(
  species  = "Homo sapiens",
  category = "H"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

hallmark_results <- enricher(
  gene          = shared_genes,
  TERM2GENE     = hallmark_sets,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
)

cat("Hallmark gene sets significant:",
    nrow(hallmark_results@result), "\n")

write.csv(hallmark_results@result,
          "Pathway/ALS_PD_shared_Hallmark.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r biomarker_scoring}
# ============================================================
# BIOMARKER CANDIDATE PRIORITISATION
# Weighted scoring framework — 5 criteria:
#   1. Cross-study consistency (datasets significant x2)
#   2. Mean absolute log2FC (effect size)
#   3. Pathway relevance (in top GO term x3)
#   4. Cross-disease evidence (in 3 diseases x4)
#   5. Tissue specificity (5 - n non-ND comparators significant)
#
# Note: Specificity scores added after internal specificity
# analysis in gse3307_specificity_test.Rmd
# ============================================================

# get consistency data for shared genes
als_consistency <- read.csv(
  "Consistency/ALS_consistency.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

pd_consistency <- read.csv(
  "Consistency/PD_consistency.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# build scoring table for shared genes
shared_scored <- shared_direction %>%
  left_join(
    als_consistency %>%
      dplyr::select(gene, n_datasets_sig,
                    mean_abs_log2FC) %>%
      rename(als_n_datasets   = n_datasets_sig,
             als_mean_abs_lfc = mean_abs_log2FC),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    pd_consistency %>%
      dplyr::select(gene, n_datasets_sig) %>%
      rename(pd_n_datasets = n_datasets_sig),
    by = "gene"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # criterion 1: cross-study consistency
    consistency_score = (replace_na(als_n_datasets, 0) +
                         replace_na(pd_n_datasets,  0)) * 2,

    # criterion 2: effect size
    effect_score = replace_na(als_mean_abs_lfc, 0),

    # criterion 3: pathway relevance (x3)
    # top GO term = skeletal muscle adaptation
    top_go_genes  = go_simplified@result$geneID[1],
    in_top_pathway = gene %in% strsplit(top_go_genes, "/")[[1]],
    pathway_score  = as.integer(in_top_pathway) * 3,

    # criterion 4: cross-disease evidence (x4)
    # check nominal significance in VCP-myopathy
    in_vcp = gene %in% vcp_sig,
    cross_disease_score = as.integer(in_vcp) * 4,

    # criterion 5: specificity added after specificity analysis
    # placeholder — updated in gse3307_specificity_test.Rmd
    specificity_score = NA_real_,

    # base score (without specificity)
    score_base = consistency_score + effect_score +
                 pathway_score + cross_disease_score
  )

cat("Shared genes scored:", nrow(shared_scored), "\n")
cat("Top candidates by base score:\n")
print(shared_scored %>%
        arrange(desc(score_base)) %>%
        dplyr::select(gene, score_base, concordant) %>%
        head(10))

write.csv(shared_scored,
          "Biomarkers/ALS_PD_shared_scored.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nBiomarker base scores saved.\n")
cat("Run gse3307_specificity_test.Rmd to add specificity scores.\n")
```

cat("ALS robust genes (2+ datasets, consistent direction):",

cat("PD robust genes:",
    nrow(consistency_results[["PD"]] %>% filter(robust)), "\n")
cat("ALS/PD shared genes (FDR < 0.05):",
    length(als_pd_shared), "\n")
cat("  - Same direction:", sum(shared_direction$concordant), "\n")
cat("  - Opposite direction:",
    sum(!shared_direction$concordant), "\n")
cat("  - Binomial test p:", round(binom_test$p.value, 3), "\n")
cat("\nFiles saved:\n")
